## Mova 1.6.0

Mova 1.6.0 为媒体库详情增加服务端主导的筛选、排序与分页。现在可以按标题或原名搜索、按发行年份筛选，并在全部媒体、电影、剧集和待复核条目之间切换；标题、年份和评分均支持稳定的升序或降序排列。待复核分类由服务端根据元数据处理状态和类型冲突统一判断，客户端不会再根据当前分页结果自行拆分分类。

Web 端新增与 App 交互一致的紧凑排序菜单和高级筛选气泡。筛选条件使用 AND 语义，排序独立生效；缺少年份或评分的条目始终排在有值条目之后。名称排序同时尊重 NFO `sort_title`、展示标题和源标题，首页预览与媒体库详情使用相同规则。

公开 API 契约版本仍为 `1`。`GET /api/libraries/{id}/media-items` 新增可选的 `category`、`sort_by` 和 `sort_order` 查询参数，现有客户端不传参数时仍保持默认的标题升序行为。

数据库迁移 `0006` 会在启动时自动原地更新媒体库标题排序索引。无需重建数据库、重新扫描媒体库或重建缓存。

---

## Mova 1.6.0

Mova 1.6.0 adds server-owned filtering, sorting, and pagination to media-library detail pages. You can now search by title or original title, filter by release year, and switch between all media, movies, series, and items that need review. Title, year, and rating support deterministic ascending or descending ordering. The server derives the needs-review category from metadata processing state and type conflicts, so clients no longer regroup the current page independently.

The Web client now provides compact App-style sorting and advanced-filter popovers. Filters use AND semantics while sorting remains independent; items without a year or rating always follow items with values. Title ordering respects NFO `sort_title`, display title, and source title, with the same rule used by library details and home previews.

The public HTTP API remains contract version `1`. `GET /api/libraries/{id}/media-items` gains optional `category`, `sort_by`, and `sort_order` query parameters. Existing clients that omit them retain the default title-ascending behavior.

Database migration `0006` automatically updates the library title-sorting index in place at startup. No database rebuild, media-library rescan, or cache rebuild is required.
